title: Scientific Account Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 We are seeking a motivated and scientifically knowledgeable Scientific Account Manager to support diagnostic platforms, devices, and products across India. This role combines scientific knowledge, customer relationship management, account management, and operational support. The successful candidate will serve as a key point of contact for partner laboratories and customers, ensuring successful platform adoption, customer satisfaction, and smooth day-to-day operations. The ideal candidate will have a background in biotechnology or life sciences, experience in account or relationship management, and excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
 
 Job Details 
 Location: Ahmedabad or Bhubaneswar Work Model: Hybrid Employment Type: Full-Time Employee Experience: Minimum 3 years 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partner accounts across India. Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with customers and laboratory partners. Establish regular communication and follow-up schedules to monitor customer satisfaction and platform utilization. Monitor account performance, testing volumes, and adoption levels, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement. Track account activities, customer feedback, issues, and escalations using CRM tools. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer concerns and ensure timely follow-through. Participate in account review meetings and provide updates and recommendations. Support customers using diagnostic platforms, devices, and products. Provide training and guidance on laboratory protocols, SOPs, workflows, and equipment. Assist with troubleshooting technical and customer-related inquiries. Support onboarding and training of new laboratory partners and staff. Communicate customer feedback and platform performance observations to the international team. Collaborate with sales, business development, marketing, and product teams to improve customer-facing materials and support processes. Support the launch and implementation of platforms at partner laboratories across India. Coordinate equipment installation, site readiness, and laboratory workflow setup. Assist with inbound and outbound shipments of samples, reagents, and equipment. Coordinate with logistics providers, freight forwarders, and customs brokers when required. Work with international operations, quality, and regulatory teams to support documentation and compliance requirements. Identify operational challenges and recommend process improvements. Represent the organization at relevant industry events, conferences, and trade shows as needed. Support the development of new markets and territories. Travel domestically and internationally when required to support strategic accounts. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Minimum Masters degree (MS) in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related scientific field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience. Background in biotechnology, life sciences, or a related scientific industry. Experience in account management, relationship management, customer success, sales, or business development. Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage confidently with customers and scientific professionals. Understanding of cancer biology, immunology, molecular biology, and cellular biology. Previous laboratory research experience. Strong problem-solving, organizational, and analytical skills. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate in a dynamic environment. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in Oncology and/or Immunology. Previous experience with laboratory equipment, particularly Luminex platforms. Experience with HubSpot CRM (other CRM platforms are also acceptable). Experience supporting diagnostic platforms, laboratory products, or biotechnology solutions. Experience working with international customers or cross-functional teams. 
 
 Working Arrangement 
 Fully remote position based in India. Primarily working according to Indian Standard Time (IST). Flexibility to attend occasional meetings with US-based teams outside standard Indian working hours. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally, potentially up to 50%, when required. Remote training and onboarding will be provided. A US B1 business visitor visa may be arranged separately for future business travel. Candidates do not need to have a US visa before starting the position. 
 
 Recruitment Process 
 The selection process consists of three interview stages. Candidates will also be asked to complete a Predictive Index assessment, which is designed to help the hiring team better understand their working style and personality. It is not intended as a disqualifying test. Important: The hiring team is particularly interested in candidates who combine strong communication and relationship-building abilities with a scientific or biotechnology background.

title: Paravet (Animal Caretaker) Professional
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a responsible and experienced Para vet (Animal Caretaker) to support daily animal healthcare activities, monitor livestock health, assist veterinarians, and maintain animal health records. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring animal welfare, identifying early signs of illness, supporting routine healthcare activities, and implementing veterinary instructions at the farm. Company: Gramathupaal Department: Animal Healthcare / Farm Operations Location: Coimbatore Reporting To: Farm Manager / Veterinarian Employment Type: Full-Time Responsibilities Monitor the health and general condition of livestock on a daily basis. Observe changes in animal behavior, appetite, movement, and milk production. Identify early signs of illness, injury, or unusual health conditions. Immediately report health concerns to the Veterinarian or Farm Manager. Monitor sick and recovering animals and update their health status. Assist veterinarians during animal examinations and treatments. Support vaccination, dewormed, and routine healthcare programs under veterinary guidance. Assist with medication administration as authorized and supervised. Support post-treatment and post-operative animal care as instructed by the veterinarian. Ensure veterinary instructions are followed properly. Monitor feeding, watering, and general animal hygiene. Ensure sick and recovering animals receive proper care. Assist in maintaining clean and hygienic animal shelters. Support preventive healthcare and disease-control activities. Observe animal comfort and report any welfare concerns. Coordinate with farm staff regarding daily animal care requirements. Coordinate with livestock owners regarding basic animal healthcare needs, where required. Provide basic animal care guidance within the scope of training and authorization. Escalate serious health conditions to qualified veterinarians. Support livestock health awareness and preventive care activities. Maintain individual animal health records. Record vaccination, dewormed, medication, and treatment details. Maintain records of illness, recovery, and veterinary visits. Update daily animal health reports to the Farm Manager. Maintain proper documentation of healthcare activities and schedules. Identify and immediately report emergency health conditions. Provide basic first aid within the scope of training. Coordinate veterinary assistance during emergencies. Follow veterinary instructions for handling sick or injured animals. Ensure timely communication of critical animal health issues. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Daily animal health monitoring and reporting. Timely identification and escalation of health issues. Proper maintenance of animal health records. Timely completion of vaccination and dewormed schedules. Proper implementation of veterinarian instructions. Maintenance of animal hygiene and welfare standards. Timely response to animal healthcare requirements. Working Hours As per farm operational requirements. Requirements Required Qualifications Certificate, Diploma, or relevant training in Veterinary Assistance, Animal Husbandry, Livestock Management, or a related field. 1-3 years of practical experience in cattle and livestock care is preferred. Knowledge of basic animal health monitoring and hygiene practices. Understanding of vaccination, dewormed, and preventive healthcare procedures. Experience working in dairy farms or livestock management is an added advantage. Required Skills Ability to handle cattle and other livestock safely and responsibly. Good observation and animal health monitoring skills. Knowledge of basic veterinary care and animal hygiene. Good communication and reporting skills. Ability to maintain accurate animal health records. Problem-solving and emergency coordination skills. Patience, responsibility, and compassion towards animals. Ability to work independently and coordinate with farm staff. Professional Limitations Responsibilities Must work under the guidance of a qualified Veterinarian wherever required. Must not independently diagnose complex diseases or claim to practice as a licensed Veterinarian. Must not independently prescribe restricted veterinary medicines or perform unauthorized procedures. All treatments, medications, and clinical procedures must follow applicable veterinary regulations and authorized protocols. Must immediately refer serious or complicated cases to a qualified Veterinarian. Preferred Candidate Immediate joiners preferred. Candidates based in or willing to work in Coimbatore. Candidates with practical experience in cattle and dairy farm management. Candidates with a strong interest in animal healthcare and livestock welfare. Candidates willing to work in a farm environment. Benefits Direct full-time employment. Salary based on experience and skill set. Opportunity to work in professional farm operations. Practical exposure to livestock healthcare and animal management. Career growth and learning opportunities.

title: Video Editor Intern
description:
Job Summary 
 Job Title: Video Editor Intern Location: Bangalore Reports to: Head of Brand Term: 3-6 months, with the possibility of a full-time role Requirement: You should already be able to turn raw footage into engaging videos for social media, with a strong sense of pacing, storytelling, sound, and captions. Your portfolio matters more than your degree or previous job titles. You'll work with our creative team in the Bangalore office. We'll provide the tools and help you develop your editing skills, while training you on shoot setup, our content calendar, and publishing. As you grow, you may take greater ownership of video edits and the posting of approved content across our channels. 
 
 Role Overview 
 You'll work under the Head of Brand, editing short-form videos each week and helping plan shoots and manage day-to-day social media tasks for Alt Carbon. Editing is the heart of this role: you'll turn footage into engaging Instagram videos, launch videos, and company content, then refine your cuts based on feedback. We're looking for someone who can use AI tools to work faster without compromising quality. For example, you might use them to create an animation that would take hours to make by hand. Experience using editing apps alongside tools such as Higgsfield, Claude, or ChatGPT is a strong plus. As you deliver consistent work, you may take greater ownership of editing and publishing approved content across our channels, with the possibility of a full-time role. 
 
 What You'll Do 
 Video editing (most of your time) Edit 15-60 second videos for Instagram, YouTube, and other channels using footage from our shoots, existing footage, and stock assets. Help us publish videos consistently each week, with strong pacing, clean audio, captions, and on-screen text. Revise edits based on feedback and prepare final versions for each platform. Organise footage and project files across our online storage and local drives so the team can find and reuse them. Use AI tools where they help you work faster without compromising quality. Support longer videos, such as explainers and mini-documentaries, as you grow into the role. Social media operations Keep the content calendar up to date with post dates, captions, assets, owners, and approval status. Schedule or publish content once it has been approved. Track basic post performance and share useful observations with the team. Find and share examples of content that could inspire our work, based on what performs well on each platform. Shoots and production support Assist with office content shoots: setup, lighting, audio, shot lists and capturing behind-the-scenes footage. Manage and organise footage, files and project folders so the team can find things fast. 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 We care more about the work you can show us than your degree or previous job titles. Please include samples of videos you edited yourself-for a client, an agency, a college project, or your own channel. Editing skills. You can turn raw footage into a finished video with clear storytelling, strong pacing, clean audio, captions, and well-placed text. A feel for short-form video. You understand hooks, jump cuts, and what makes people keep watching on Reels and Shorts. Confidence with editing tools. You\'re comfortable using Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or a similar editor, and can work efficiently. Reliability. You meet deadlines, flag delays early, and keep your files organised. Openness to feedback. You can take notes, make revisions, and improve an edit without losing the story. Fast learning. You pick up new tools and workflows quickly and put what you learn into practice.
